root_cause: Platform ui_accept and ui_cancel defaults lacked joypad events; menu back handlers and initial focus were also incomplete.
input_method: Joypad button events sent through Viewport GUI dispatch; analog events through Input.parse_input_event. Uses nonzero device IDs 7 and 5. No direct button callback substitution.
notes: Popup cancellation stays on the current page; pause cancel resumes driving.
Disabled power options are skipped; selection-page rebuilds restore focus.
Mouse, keyboard bindings and original keyboard UI mappings are preserved.
